title: Decoding Memes: Benchmarking Narrative Role Classification across Multilingual and Multimodal Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing zero-shot classification performance (Precision, Recall, F1 scores) of various text-only and multimodal models across monolingual English meme datasets versus a low-resource code-mixed (English-Hindi/Hinglish) meme dataset.

Using t-SNE embedding visualizations and qualitative case studies to assess models' ability to interpret culturally nuanced, region-specific visual and textual narratives compared to Western/US-centric meme contexts.

Analyzing model error patterns and confusion matrices to detect inductive biases, specifically highlighting models' tendencies to over-predict the 'villain' category due to affective language and explicit societal stereotypes embedded in pre-training datasets.
